name: Files
description: Local file reading, writing, and patch editing.

apply_patch.description: Apply structured patches to local files when supported by the host.

file_read.description: Read files or directories with OpenCode-style text pagination and native media transport.

file_write.description: Create or completely overwrite a text file and return its diff.

file_edit.description: Precisely replace exact text in an existing file and return its diff.
